اسبغلا (form IVq)
# اِسْبَغَلَّا (isbaḡallā) /is.ba.ɣal.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
# اِسْبَغِلَّا (isbaḡillā) /is.ba.ɣil.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْبَغَلَّ (isbaḡalla)
